title: Guest Towel Holder Countertop Stand 16.3-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
short_title: Guest Towel Holder Countertop Stand 16.3-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Add convenient towel storage at the sink with this countertop guest towel holder, crafted from solid brass and designed with two arms for hand towels and washcloths. Its heavy base helps prevent tipping, and a felt pad helps protect countertop surfaces—ideal for everyday use in a bathroom vanity area.

Highlights:
- Two-arm stand keeps guest towels within reach of the sink
- Solid brass construction for durable, enduring daily use
- Heavy base helps prevent tipping on the countertop
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on vanity and counter surfaces
- Coordinates with the Carolina collection for a cohesive look

Specs:
- Product type: Freestanding guest towel holder / towel stand
- Mounting type: Countertop (freestanding)
- Overall size: 16.3-Inch L x 5.5-Inch W x 14-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 20 lb
- Product weight: 5.6 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Freestanding towel holder
- Finish options: Multiple designer finishes available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Style note: Designed to complement transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.
